answer_1.quote: This paper systematically compares stories and rules as commonsense expressions to retrieve and leverage commonsense knowledge in LLMs.
datasets: AI2 Science Questions (AI2Sci, elementary and middle school set)
answer_1.outputs: stories and rules as commonsense expressions

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity to indicate the generation confidence of LLMs...

answer_3.quote: we ask ChatGPT to determine if each story or rule aligns with commonsense, responding with either "yes" or "no" (prompt shown in Table  in Appendix A).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a manual evaluation of the generated stories and rules. For each model, we sample 50 stories and 50 rules from the Commonsense QA dataset and manually label each one for commonsense correctness. The annotators are the authors of this paper.
answer_4.guideline: A story or rule is marked as incorrect if it contains a description that contradicts real-world commonsense.
